articles.title_en: Lavrov: US aggression against Iran at the time of negotiations raises questions
articles.lead_en: For the second time in a row, aggression against the republic begins in the midst of negotiations, the Russian Foreign Minister noted.

articles.title_en: Lavrov: The US set up its Arab allies by launching aggression against Iran
articles.lead_en: According to the head of the Russian Foreign Ministry, “it is clear that US military bases in the region were used to collect and transmit intelligence data and information from satellites.”

articles.title_en: Lavrov called US bravado about the assassination of Iran's leadership cynical
articles.lead_en: It is impossible to perceive in any other way the way the administration of the American leader talks about this, the Russian Foreign Minister noted.
